# FLOAT16_PI_SQUARED

> [π][@stdlib/constants/float16/pi]².

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var FLOAT16_PI_SQUARED = require( '@stdlib/constants/float16/pi-squared' );
```

#### FLOAT16_PI_SQUARED

Square of the mathematical constant [π][@stdlib/constants/float16/pi].

```javascript
var bool = ( FLOAT16_PI_SQUARED === 9.859375 );
// returns true
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->
